title: Spicy Korean-Style Foie Gras Soup
description: A rich and spicy soup that combines the luxurious taste of foie gras with the bold flavors of Korean cuisine.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the sesame oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and sauté until fragrant.
Add the Korean chili flakes and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the soy sauce, sugar, and Korean soup stock.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Cut the foie gras into small pieces and add to the pot.
Simmer for an additional 5 minutes, or until the foie gras is cooked through.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with chopped green onions.
